description: Ask whether to prepare the deliverable with Bestie Check before stopping. Never approves spend and never calls verify_deliverable.

hooks.prompt: You are about to stop. If this turn produced or is about to return a document deliverable, ASK the user whether to prepare it with Bestie Check and read its Claim and Assumption Quick Look. Do not call verify_deliverable unless the user has approved a specific quote. Do not set approvalRef on your own. Do not pass --approve, --approve-quote, or --approve-up-to unless the user gave them. Do not spend credits. Plugins and hooks never mint quote-bound approval. If no document deliverable is being handed off, or Check already completed and was disclosed, respond {"ok": true}. If a deliverable is being handed off and Check has not been offered, respond {"ok": false, "reason": "Ask the user whether to prepare this deliverable with Bestie Check before finishing. Do not approve spend."}.
